name: float-layer
title: Float layer
author: Sanjay Kumar <https://github.com/luv-jeri>
description: An entrance, scroll depth and gentle idle movement for a real component or a group of elements.

props.name: depth
props.description: Total native-scroll displacement in px. Negative values reverse the plane.

props.name: delay
props.description: Entrance delay in seconds; bounded to one second.

props.name: drift
props.description: Gentle idle excursion in px. Set zero for scroll-only depth.

props.name: replay
props.description: Repeat the entrance when the layer leaves and re-enters the viewport.

props.name: revealDuration
props.description: Entrance duration in seconds, clamped to 0.2–2.

props.name: revealDistance
props.description: Initial vertical entrance offset in px, clamped to 0–80.
